sarah (Design): Heads-up — noticed a couple of a11y nits while testing the new compact panels today. mainly around keyboard shortcut hints and focus visibility. :eyes: kevin (Frontend): ok what specifically? tia (Accessibility): can you paste screenshots or repro steps? sarah (Design): steps: Open Dashboard > open compact panel (right rail) > press ? to bring up shortcuts overlay. the overlay's hint text is 10/11 contrast on dark bg — fails WCAG for small text. also the focus ring on panel controls is 1px and gets lost against the border. kevin (Frontend): doh. for the ? overlay we use our Tooltip component with .tooltip--muted text-color. maybe the token changed in the last theme PR. kevin (Frontend): quick CSS diff I tried locally: ```css .tooltip__body { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 12px; } /* suggestion */ .tooltip__body.a11y-contrast { color: #dce3ea; } ``` sarah (Design): that shade looks better. also the tooltip arrow is overlapping the content area on small widths — makes it hard to read. tia (Accessibility): contrast first is good. for focus ring, can we make it 2px and use outline-offset 2px for compact controls? something like: ```css button.compact:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(34,139,230,0.45); outline: none; } ``` tia (Accessibility): and add an invisible focus-target padding so small icons still get keyboard target size 44px. kevin (Frontend): agree. I'll bump ring to 2px and add padding. question: do we change global focus tokens or just panel-scoped? oliver (DevEx): prefer scoped changes first then evaluate global token shift. risk of cascade is high. sarah (Design): scoped for now. also the shortcut overlay uses role="dialog" but missing aria-label. NVDA reads as "dialog" and user has no context. tia (Accessibility): yeah add either aria-label or aria-labelledby pointing to the overlay heading. Prefer labelledby if we have a visual heading. example: ```html

Keyboard shortcuts

``` kevin (Frontend): good call. will update. a11y-bot: Auto-scan report: 3 issues found in /dashboard/compact-panel overlay: 1) contrast ratio 3.8:1 for tooltip text, 2) missing aria-labelledby on shortcuts dialog, 3) focusable icon buttons with <20px hit area. See https://ci.example/reports/1847501123 for details. sarah (Design): thanks bot. Can we also add a short on-hover hint or discoverability UI for the `?` trigger? some users miss it. maybe add a tiny label "Shortcuts" next to the icon on hover or accessible label for screen readers. tia (Accessibility): if we add visible text on hover, ensure it doesn't rely on hover-only (keyboard-only users). better: persist a sr-only label and show visual label on hover/focus. e.g., ```html ``` kevin (Frontend): implementation plan: 1) scoped CSS changes for focus ring + hit-target (PR today), 2) update tooltip color token and arrow positioning (PR), 3) add aria-labelledby to dialog and sr-only label for button (PR). I'll link PRs here. sarah (Design): thanks. can we target this for the next patch release? it's low-risk but high-impact. :+1: oliver (DevEx): sounds reasonable. please add unit/integration tests: axe checks on overlay, keyboard nav e2e to tab into overlay and back out. kevin (Frontend): will add axe snapshot and a small Playwright test. tia (Accessibility): i'll run NVDA/VoiceOver passes once PRs are up. tag me @tia. sarah (Design): sweet. small follow-up: the compact panel's header visually truncates labels; if we add visible "Shortcuts" text on hover it should not cause layout shift. keep it overlayed. kevin (Frontend): noted — overlayed label on hover, no reflow. a11y-bot: Reminder: create issue with priority P2 and add to milestone "patch-2026-03" if fixes are merged before freeze. sarah (Design): added a checklist in the thread: 1) PRs for focus/contrast/aria (kevin) 2) e2e + axe tests (kevin) 3) NVDA/VO manual pass (tia) 4) design review for hover label (sarah) 5) ship in patch release (oliver). kevin (Frontend): starting work now, will post PR links when ready. tia (Accessibility): ack, will watch and test. sarah (Design): thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. :sparkles:
